result:
The fix works on the device. PR #289 is now marked ready. Both Volume texture captures from #283 dropped sharply, and nothing else in the six test suites changed.

**Why the last session stopped:** it was correctly waiting for the device test. That test was moved from the Thor to the Nova at 21:11Z and had finished on the Nova by about 22:24Z. No verdict comment had been posted on the PR when this session started, so I read the results straight from the two result folders.

**Result** (Nova, 2 runs of each build, both runs of a build identical, all 186 captures scored):

| capture | before (master) | after (fix) |
|---|---|---|
| Volume_texture/Y16 | 65,819 px, read as white-content | 2,605 px, read as ok |
| Volume_texture/R16B16 | 48,412 px | 1,638 px |
| the other 184 captures | – | unchanged in every scored column |

- **Nothing else moved:** that includes the 2D 16-bit texture-format captures and the 16-bit bump-map captures that #10 covers. The case that would have disproved the fix (a 2D 16-bit format shifting) did not happen.
- **Y16 is not fully fixed:** I had estimated about 100 px left, but 2,605 remain. The red and green channels are exact everywhere; what's left is almost all ±1 in blue, the texel's low byte. I recorded this in NOTES.md, with a byte-typed image view as the next step to try, but did not pursue it because the brief said not to extend the work.
- **Merge with master:** the PR had fallen 96 commits behind master and could not merge. I merged master in rather than rebasing, so the prediction's references still hold. The only conflict was the generated test index (`docs/testing/nv2a_index.json`), which I rebuilt from the pinned test trees. Preflight passes, the PR now merges cleanly, and CI is running on the new head (`6b449f0fd9`).

I updated the PR description with the result table (the `Files:` line still matches the diff), added this session to `docs/lanes/texvol283/NOTES.md`, and posted the summary on both PR #289 and issue #283.

The Claude Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need to be authorized in your claude.ai connector settings before they can be used. None of them were needed for this lane.
